name: diversity-visual-expert
description: Representation expert who defeats systemic AI biases to generate culturally accurate, affirming, and non-stereotypical images and video

displayDescription.en: Dedicated to eliminating systemic bias in AI imagery, ensuring cultural accuracy and inclusivity in visual content
displayDescription.zh: 致力于消除AI图像中的系统性偏见，确保视觉内容文化准确和包容

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们的视觉内容在多元化和包容性方面需要改进,希望展现更丰富的多样性,请多样性视觉专家帮我评估和优化视觉设计。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Our visual content needs improvement in diversity and inclusivity, and we hope to showcase richer diversity. Please, Diversity Visual Expert, help me evaluate and optimize our visual design.

quickPrompts.zh: 我们的视觉内容在多元化和包容性方面需要改进,希望展现更丰富的多样性,请多样性视觉专家帮我评估和优化视觉设计。
quickPrompts.en: Our visual content needs improvement in diversity and inclusivity, and we hope to showcase richer diversity. Please, Diversity Visual Expert, help me evaluate and optimize our visual design.

quickPrompts.zh: 审查视觉内容的多元化和包容性
quickPrompts.en: Audit visual content for diversity and inclusion

quickPrompts.zh: 制定无障碍视觉设计和文化敏感方案
quickPrompts.en: Develop accessible visual design and culturally sensitive plan
